purpose: Freeze the complete H2 screening-adjudication instructions with the English-only boundary and exact database decision vocabulary.
adjudication_rule: Review every supplied H2 row using its source title/abstract and the two primary decisions. Enter a fresh H2 judgment; do not mechanically copy either primary stream.
mapping_rule: Use exactly one listed exclusion code for every exclude decision and no exclusion code for include or uncertain.
evidence_rule: Except when both title and abstract are genuinely absent and E_INSUFFICIENT_METADATA is used, language_evidence and evidence_span must be exact nonblank title or abstract substrings.
provenance_rule: For artifacts governed by this composite protocol, row-level independent_ai_prompt_sha256 and manifest prompt_sha256 must equal the SHA-256 of this JSON file.
